summary: Studio Art Engine is a React + TypeScript single-page application for designing and generating layered generative NFT collections entirely in the browser. Users create projects, build layered trait libraries (with per-layer opacity/blend compositing), tune rarity weights, enforce compatibility rules, preview randomized mixes, forge custom 1-of-1 tokens, and generate full collections via a Web Worker with progress/cancel support. Generated assets can be browsed with search/filter/sort and exported (single items, collection metadata JSON, or a ZIP). Publishing is a Pinata-only IPFS workflow gated by “Lock collection”, with JWT validation, upload progress tracking, and automatic metadata IPFS URI injection. The codebase also contains scaffolding for Internet Identity + backend actor integration and a Motoko blob-storage maintenance/authorization mixin.

existing_features.title: Multi-project dashboard (create/open/edit/delete)
existing_features.description: Create projects (name, symbol, collection size, pixel-art mode), open a project into the editor, edit key project fields, and delete projects with confirmation.

existing_features.title: In-app navigation with responsive header + mobile menu
existing_features.description: Header-based navigation between Workshop, Rarity, Rules, Preview, Forge, Vault, and Settings for the active project, including a mobile menu and a back-to-projects action.

existing_features.title: Project schema validation, sanitization, and migrations
existing_features.description: Runtime validation of loaded/updated project objects, sanitization with defaults, and migrations including legacy rule shape conversion, legacy outputWidth/outputHeight -> outputSize, and deriving blockchain from Settings.metadataFormat.

existing_features.title: Client-side persistence via debounced atomic localStorage snapshot
existing_features.description: Debounced autosave overwrites a single canonical localStorage key (last-write-wins), validates before save, warns near quota, and includes cleanup for legacy temp/backup keys.

existing_features.title: Autosave status indicator with layout-stable header integration
existing_features.description: Shows non-intrusive “Saving…” / “Saved” status with fixed-width indicator and header layout configured to avoid navigation button reflow when status changes.

existing_features.title: Global destructive-action confirmation dialog (promise-based)
existing_features.description: Centralized confirmation modal backed by a Zustand store; confirm() returns a Promise<boolean> used for destructive actions (e.g., deleting projects, unlocking collection).

existing_features.title: Workshop: layer management (add/select/rename/delete/reorder)
existing_features.description: Create layers, select a layer to edit, inline-rename layers, delete layers, and reorder layers via drag-and-drop.

existing_features.title: Workshop: per-layer compositing controls (opacity + blend mode)
existing_features.description: Configure layer opacity (0–100) and blend mode (normal/multiply/overlay) for canvas compositing used across Preview/Forge/Vault workflows.

existing_features.title: Workshop: trait asset management (upload/preview/rename/delete)
existing_features.description: Upload multiple image traits per layer (stored as data URLs), auto-name from filenames, preview thumbnails, inline-rename traits, and delete traits with error handling and toast feedback.

existing_features.title: Rule reference hygiene on layer/trait deletion
existing_features.description: When deleting layers or traits, rules are updated to remove invalid references; rules with deleted primaries or empty incompatible sets are removed.

existing_features.title: Matching rules system (exclude/force) with CRUD + duplicate UI
existing_features.description: Create/edit/delete/duplicate rules of type exclude/force via a two-panel trait-selection modal with validation (requires primary + at least one target, prevents self-reference).

existing_features.title: Rarity Workshop: weight initialization, normalization, locking, redistribution
existing_features.description: Auto-initializes missing/invalid weights, normalizes to sum to 100.00, supports trait locking, proportionally redistributes weights on slider updates, provides equalize/randomize actions, and shows expected counts and rare (<1%) highlighting.

existing_features.title: Preview: weighted random mix with rule validation + canvas compositing
existing_features.description: Generates random trait selections based on weights, validates against rules with bounded attempts, composites layers to a canvas using blend/opacity, and supports pixel-art mode; uses square outputSize from settings.

existing_features.title: Forge: Genesis Craft (trait-by-trait selection) with live preview
existing_features.description: Allows selecting one trait per layer and renders a live composite preview canvas while choosing traits.

existing_features.title: Forge: mint Genesis Craft output into custom token library
existing_features.description: Creates a composite PNG from chosen traits and saves it as a custom token with a selected token number for inclusion as a forged item in generation.

existing_features.title: Forge: Direct Injection upload queue + batch commit
existing_features.description: Upload arbitrary image assets into a queue, remove items, and commit them in a batch as custom tokens with assigned token numbers.

existing_features.title: Custom token (forged) library browsing and deletion
existing_features.description: Displays forged/custom tokens and supports deletion (also removes generated NFTs that reference the deleted forged token).

existing_features.title: Vault: worker-based collection generation with progress, batching, and cancel
existing_features.description: Starts a module Web Worker to generate NFTs, receives capability/progress/batch/complete messages, supports cancellation, and progressively commits batched results into project state (replace-only model clears previous results at start).

existing_features.title: Deterministic DNA generation and uniqueness enforcement
existing_features.description: Creates deterministic DNA strings from ordered layer IDs + selected trait IDs; prevents duplicates during generation and during per-item regeneration workflows.

existing_features.title: Typed generator worker protocol with capability detection
existing_features.description: Shared TypeScript protocol defines start/cancel inputs and capability/progress/batch/complete/cancelAck/error outputs plus type guards used by both UI and worker.

existing_features.title: Vault: main-thread compositing fallback with UI yielding + image cache
existing_features.description: When the worker cannot composite images, the UI composites missing images on the main thread using selectedTraits, uses a simple image cache, and yields periodically to avoid UI freezes.

existing_features.title: Vault browsing: search, trait filters, sorting, view modes, and detail modal
existing_features.description: Browse generated NFTs with full-text search, per-layer multi-trait filters (with clear-all), sorting by index/rarity/commonness, compact vs grid view modes, and a detail modal with quick-filter buttons.

existing_features.title: Vault rarity analytics: frequency map, ranks, and tiers
existing_features.description: Computes trait frequencies (excluding forged) and derives rarity scores, ranks items, and assigns tiers (Legendary for forged, otherwise Epic/Ultra Rare/Rare/Uncommon/Common by percentile).

existing_features.title: Vault: regenerate a single NFT with uniqueness + rule validation
existing_features.description: Regenerates a selected non-forged NFT by selecting new traits with rule validation and DNA uniqueness checks, then recomposites and replaces the NFT in state.

existing_features.title: Exports: single NFT assets, collection metadata JSON, and ZIP download
existing_features.description: Export a single NFT’s PNG + metadata JSON, export collection metadata JSON, and download a ZIP containing images/{id}.png, json/{id}.json, and _metadata.json created in-app.

existing_features.title: Low-memory (headless) mode during generation
existing_features.description: Optional low-memory mode hides the vault grid while generating to reduce memory pressure; progress remains visible.

existing_features.title: Settings: metadata configuration with live preview
existing_features.description: Configure output size, token name template, token description, start-at-zero toggle, royalties %, and see a live metadata preview derived from settings.

existing_features.title: Settings: metadata format selection drives blockchain (ICP option disabled)
existing_features.description: Selecting Solana/Ethereum metadata format updates project.blockchain accordingly; ICP is shown but disabled as “coming soon”.

existing_features.title: Settings: Pinata JWT storage, guide dialog, and debounced validation
existing_features.description: Per-project Pinata JWT input stored locally; debounced validation against Pinata’s testAuthentication endpoint; includes an in-app step-by-step guide dialog explaining how to obtain the JWT token.

existing_features.title: Settings: Pinata free-plan limit warning note
existing_features.description: Displays a clear English warning note that Pinata’s free plan is suitable for small-to-medium collections and large collections likely require a paid upgrade.

existing_features.title: Settings: Solana creators management with validation
existing_features.description: For Solana metadata format, configure multiple creator wallet addresses and share percentages, validate presence and that shares sum to 100%.

existing_features.title: IPFS publishing pipeline via Pinata with lock-to-upload gate + progress tracking
existing_features.description: Lock/unlock collection gating; upload images as a directory for a single CID; build and upload master metadata JSON with ipfs:// image URIs; track upload progress and store resulting CIDs in project state.

existing_features.title: Vault publishing controls (Lock/Unlock/Upload/Retry) with compact status + tooltips
existing_features.description: Always-visible Vault publishing toolbar showing compact status and providing Lock/Unlock/Upload actions with hover tooltips; supports retry after failure.

existing_features.title: Metadata preset utilities with template resolution and chain-specific fields
existing_features.description: Generates preview/final metadata using {{collection}}/{{id}} templates, supports Solana/Ethereum/ICP formats, injects IPFS URIs when available, and omits Solana-only royalty fields from Ethereum outputs.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication context (scaffolding)
existing_features.description: InternetIdentityProvider initializes AuthClient, restores stored delegations, provides login/logout, and exposes status and identity to the app.

existing_features.title: Backend actor creation hook using React Query (scaffolding)
existing_features.description: React Query hook creates/caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor based on Internet Identity and invalidates/refetches dependent queries when identity changes.

existing_features.title: Motoko blob-storage authorization and maintenance mixin (backend library)
existing_features.description: Backend includes Motoko modules for gateway principal authorization, dead blob listing/pruning, and cashier cycle top-up endpoints via an included mixin.

existing_features.title: No-backend query layer placeholder
existing_features.description: Includes an intentionally empty queries hook file documenting that core workflows are client-side (localStorage persistence) with no backend queries.

architectural_notes: React SPA with view-state routing in App.tsx (dashboard/workshop/rarity/rules/preview/forge/vault/settings) rather than URL routing.

Strongly-typed domain model (Project/Layers/Traits/Rules/GeneratedNFT/etc.) with runtime validation, sanitization, and small migrations on load (legacy rules, outputWidth/outputHeight -> outputSize, blockchain derived from metadataFormat).
Local-only persistence: debounced autosave writes a single canonical localStorage snapshot (atomic overwrite) plus best-effort cleanup of legacy temp/backup keys and near-quota warnings.
Off-main-thread generation via a module Web Worker; UI/worker communication uses a shared typed message protocol (union types + type guards).

Worker performs trait selection, rule validation, deterministic DNA creation, uniqueness checks, batching, and optional OffscreenCanvas compositing; UI provides main-thread compositing fallback with periodic yielding to keep the UI responsive.

Pinata-only IPFS publishing is implemented as utilities (Pinata API wrapper + collection upload pipeline) and surfaced via Vault/Settings UI with a lock-to-upload gate and publishing state machine on the project.
Metadata generation is encapsulated in metadata preset utilities supporting template placeholders ({{collection}}, {{id}}), Solana/Ethereum/ICP format mapping, and IPFS URI injection when publishing.
UI built with TailwindCSS and shadcn-ui primitives; Sonner toasts for feedback; Lucide icons; custom motion/animation utilities centralized in CSS/Tailwind config.
Destructive confirmations are centralized via a Zustand store and a global AlertDialog with a Promise-based confirm() API.

Authentication/Backend scaffolding uses an InternetIdentityProvider (AuthClient) and a React Query-powered useActor() hook to create authenticated/anonymous canister actors and invalidate dependent queries on identity changes.
known_issues: The generation worker composites at a fixed 800×800 (OffscreenCanvas(800,800)) regardless of project.settings.outputSize, so generated images may not match the configured output size used elsewhere (Preview/Forge).

Vault/worker metadata builders hardcode Solana creators as 'YOUR_WALLET_ADDRESS' and do not incorporate Settings.solanaCreators; publishing/export uses metadataPresets, so metadata may differ between generation-time and export/publish-time.

Weighted random selection in Preview/Vault/worker assumes layer trait weights meaningfully cover 0–100; if weights sum to <100 (or all 0), selection can fail to choose a trait and reduce valid-generation success rates.

normalizeProjects() intentionally clears generatedNFTs for all projects except the most recently generated one on load/save, which can surprise users expecting multiple projects to retain generated collections.

localStorage persistence stores images as base64 data URLs and can hit browser quota quickly; on quota failure autosave sets status='failed' but the SaveStatusIndicator visually hides failed state (errors mostly in console).
Settings.tsx keeps a localSettings state initialized from project.settings only on first mount; switching projects while Settings remains mounted can show stale values until remount.
If customTokens (forged tokens) exceed collectionSize, the worker’s shuffled token-number assignment can produce undefined/invalid token numbers and metadata.
Vault rarity scoring/filtering maps metadata attributes by layer/trait names (not stable IDs); renaming layers/traits after generation can break analytics and filtering behavior.

IPFS publishing and some export paths assume nft.imageData exists and is a PNG data URL; direct-injected assets may be JPEG/GIF, and missing/corrupt imageData can cause failures with limited diagnostics.
Cancellation responsiveness can lag if the worker is in the middle of an expensive per-NFT image generation/compositing step (cancel is checked between iterations).
